entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-08
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Reduce PR validation time by conditionally filtering tests based on changed files #55203
  • Use a shared EvaluationContext for ReleasePropertyProjectLocator pre-evaluation (pack/publish) #55193

Closed

  • `dotnet test` Microsoft.Testing.Platform experience #45927
    10.0.1xx
  • RuntimeProcessLauncherTests.RelaunchOnCrash: IOException file used by another process #55098
  • MetadataUpdateHandlerTests.NoActions: IOException file used by another process (Program.cs) #55164
  • Dotnet format doesn’t work on runtime corelib #53595
  • Flaky: GivenDotnetTestBuildsAndRunsTestFromCsprojForMultipleTFM.XunitMultiTFM fails with FluentAssertions output mismatch #55194
  • CA1416 when property accessor is unsupported on Mac Catalyst #50337
  • Add a linux NAOT build leg #55077
    11.0.1xx

PullRequests

Created

  • [release/dnup] Fail loudly instead of masking a broken dotnetup with dotnet-install fallback #55209
  • Preserve dotnetup output and return only the exit code from Invoke-DotnetupNativeCommand #55208
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.4xx' #55207
  • Verify SHA-512 of the downloaded get-dotnetup script in eng #55206
  • Enable same-OS cross-arch NativeAOT builds; cross-build arm64 AoT legs on x64 #55205
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-dotnet AOT
  • Add agent-assisted AI-artifact upkeep check #55204
  • [release/10.0.4xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55202
  • Fix composite ReadyToRun publish when RelativePath has a path component #55200
    Area-ReadyToRun
  • Add add-cli-command skill for dotnet CLI command/option changes #55199
  • Add location-gated AGENTS.md guidance for key src and test subtrees #55198
  • Use net11 azurelinux container images in main #55196
  • `dotnetup`: Add support for Fish shell #55192
  • [release/10.0.1xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55191
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55190

Merged

  • Add `dotnet test --list-devices` support for MAUI #54565
    Area-CLI
  • Replace ubuntu22 VM and Helix images with Azure Linux 3 #53792
  • Fix intermittent file-lock race in dotnet-watch tests #55201
  • Fix check for a project being properly loaded #54983
  • Run multi-TFM tests sequentially to fix XunitMultiTFM/MStestMultiTFM flakiness #55197
  • Fix: Unsupported maccatalyst attribute is getting applied to child attributes but not accounted parent child attributes merge #50334
    Area-Infrastructure, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Fix stale KBE action to use last summary table in issue body #55195
  • Add Linux NativeAOT build legs (x64 + arm64) #55143
    Area-dotnet AOT, 11.0-preview7
  • [automated] Merge branch 'release/8.0.1xx' => 'release/8.0.4xx' #55168
  • Don't generate embedded ValidatableTypeAttribute for .NET 11 and later #55163

Updated

  • Dotnetup: add `env` command to update PathPreference mode #54545
  • Skip full Build for AOT publish, use Compile instead #54515
    breaking-change
  • Fix `dotnet sln` failing to parse `.slnf` files with unescaped backslashes in path #54622
  • Update GenerateRuntimeConfigurationFiles task to generate Hot Reload runtime options #53715
  • Conditional test filtering framework for PR builds #55166
  • [release/11.0.1xx-preview6] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55161
    Area-Roslyn
  • fix: normalize IntermediateOutputPath slashes in posix platforms #54536
    Area-Watch
  • Performance improvements in SymbolNamesWithValueOption<T> #54120
    Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • [release/10.0.3xx] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #55175
  • Convert dotnet-format integration tests from pipeline YAML to XUnit/Helix #54231
  • Migrate DefineStaticWebAssets to multithreaded task execution #55117
  • Migrate GenerateStaticWebAssetEndpointsManifest to IMultiThreadableTask #54706
  • Use AnalysisMode=minimum in Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers and fix errors (perf rules) #54125
    Area-Infrastructure, stale, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • CA1860 should be reported for derived types as well (analyzer fix with performance improvements) #54124
    stale, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • Reduce allocations in EnumsShouldHaveZeroValueAnalyzer #54123
    stale, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
  • [Proposal] Use Span-based methods to split strings in analyzers #54121
    Area-Infrastructure, stale, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers

    stale, Area-Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers
